requested_outcome: Give the events world a distinctive image-led landing like the spa reference and replace its first quick-search row with a visual slider managed from the VII content studio.
authorization_boundary: Implementation, verification and the already-authorized VII publication path are in scope. No supplier facts, unverified images, permissions or unrelated production settings may be invented or changed.

lesson_bundle.reason: The public page and the administration reflection both need end-to-end evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require public desktop and mobile evidence plus save, reload, publish and reflection evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user explicitly requires operational back-office control.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require versioned fields, publish state, persistence, preview path and public reflection.

lesson_bundle.reason: The quick-search content must remain managed rather than hard-coded only.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require editable labels, copy, images, targets, visibility and order.

lesson_bundle.reason: The event hero and horizontal rail materially change mobile layout.
The slider introduces visible links and arrows.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require truthful enabled and disabled arrow states and working card destinations.

lesson_bundle.reason: Existing event catalog, search and lower sections must be preserved.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Compare the changed top section while regression-testing the unchanged event family.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The page gets a large banner but still feels generic or the search is cut off.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use the approved spa composition as structural precedent, reserve explicit space for search and inspect desktop and mobile geometry.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Hero title, description, images, proof points and complete search are visible without overlap at desktop and 390 pixels.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The quick searches remain plain pills rather than a visual discovery slider.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Build image-led cards with the shared slider controls and boundary states.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The first event discovery section visibly uses image cards and only actionable arrows are enabled.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Management controls exist but do not affect the public page after reload.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Read the published version from the same D1 content source used by the public event page.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A managed edit survives admin reload and the published values appear on /events while drafts do not.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The change damages event search, catalog sections or mobile spacing.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve all lower sections and run the event family plus full build and focused regressions.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Search submission, breadcrumbs, event sections, card links and responsive page flow remain functional.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Images or Hebrew typography look wrong or unverified.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use current verified event catalog media and the existing self-hosted modern Hebrew stack.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every changed image resolves from approved catalog assets with editable alt text and visible Hebrew uses Heebo without fallback.

affected_family: content studio events inventory and editor

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the event presentation model, hero and visual quick-search component render locally from default content
checks: Desktop event hero is complete and search is not clipped
Visual quick-search rail renders working links and correct arrow boundaries
The events landing management item exposes the required fields

attack_questions: Can a draft accidentally change the public page?
Can a malformed or empty managed slider make the landing unusable?
Do slider arrows misrepresent whether movement is possible?
Does the hero or search overlap at 390 pixels or low height?
Did any existing event section or destination disappear?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Open the exact public /events route and authenticated /admin/content-studio events item, then exercise save, reload, publish and public reflection.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Run focused event, content-studio, slider, typography and responsive checks plus the production build.

effectiveness.baseline: Current /events has a generic search band, title section and text-chip quick searches with no page-level visual management.
effectiveness.target: One coherent event entry screen and one operational content item controlling its visible discovery content.
